# Infinitech Advertising Corporation

> Infinitech Advertising Corporation is a digital and creative company based in Makati, Philippines. It specializes in web development and mobile app development, and also offers digital marketing, SEO, advertising, photography, videography, and branding services for businesses across Metro Manila and the Philippines.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Infinitech Advertising Corporation
- Location: Campos Rueda Building, 311 Urban Ave, Makati City, 1206 Metro Manila, Philippines
- Founded: 2024
- Website: https://infinitechphil.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Infinitech-Advertising-Corporation-61562146592005/
- Service area: Philippines (Metro Manila and nationwide)
- Accepts interns

## Services

- Web development: custom websites, web applications, e-commerce, business websites
- Mobile app development: Android, iOS, cross-platform apps
- Digital marketing and SEO
- Advertising and branding
- Photography and videography, including video production

## Note

Not to be confused with unrelated companies with similar names, such as Infinity Advertising (India), Infinity Broadcasting Corporation, or Infinitech Solutions.
